text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 19 mm overall (13 mm clear of the long leg). No bending.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pawl, 21 mm from the front edge, 40 mm up. Two 6.6 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: foot with two M5 screws; bond the 3 mm polyurethane pad on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 45 degrees by 4 mm; tap M3 in the tail for the solenoid plunger.
